summary: This is a Makefile target named 'hello' that prints a greeting message. When you run 'make hello', it echoes a message that includes a variable called 'firstname', which gets substituted with its actual value.

explanations.1: This defines a target (a named recipe) in a Makefile called 'hello' that can be invoked by running 'make hello'.
explanations.2: The @symbol suppresses printing the command itself before executing it; echo outputs text, and ${firstname} is a variable placeholder that will be replaced with the firstname variable's value.
